review.salesforce-einstein.faq.q1: How much does Salesforce Einstein cost?
review.salesforce-einstein.faq.a1: Pricing varies based on deployment model, users, and features. Contact Salesforce for specific quotes tailored to your organization's needs.
review.salesforce-einstein.faq.q2: What data sources does Salesforce Einstein support?
review.salesforce-einstein.faq.a2: Salesforce Einstein supports 100+ native connectors including major databases, cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and file formats.
review.salesforce-einstein.faq.a3: No, Salesforce Einstein features an intuitive visual interface that doesn't require coding for most analyses. Advanced users can leverage scripting for complex scenarios.
